objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types that go through creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, Work Instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level (1-4) indicating the strategic or operational scope of the document.

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g. RL for guideline).

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive 4-digit number per document type included in the document name.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Descriptive title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented upon revision.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date based on Valid From plus period of extended validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span for validity checks, default 3 years.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period for archived documents, default 10 years.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language version of the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to related master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: Referenced IT applications maintained as document property.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity assigned to the document.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata printed in the document via TAG technology.

attributes.name: client
attributes.description: Client in a multi-client system in which the document is visible.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document attached to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current status of the attachment aligned with the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal created by an author to suggest changes to an existing released document without affecting its content or version history until scheduled.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, processed via workflow to extend or revise the document.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: Request created to invalidate a released document and trigger archiving when the document has no additional validity.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in roles such as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator or reader.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or change authorizations and distribution lists to documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of User Groups and persons maintained per document to control email notifications and acknowledgement requests upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported process instance that guides document release, validity extension, override or reactivation through defined steps with electronic signatures.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: An organizational entity such as a department or location that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: A business process that can be linked to documents for process-specific filing.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: A risk object that can be linked to documents.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature provided by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object with selection of the corresponding document type.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office component.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step of the release process.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and formal correctness within the release workflow.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling it for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created due to content changes, attribute changes, attachment changes or scheduled change proposals.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the document's version or release cycle.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is planned for implementation, creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of a change proposal, notifying the creator upon completion.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser or release participants confirm the continued validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, revoking all rights except for the archive group and starting the archive duration.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A Business Admin group member creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, restoring authorizations and creating a new version.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or change authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User Groups or persons are assigned to a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested to confirm acknowledgement of a released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A user confirms acknowledgement of a document via the workflow-supported acknowledgement task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Released document content is translated into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated language version of a document is checked and released via workflow.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: An external file is uploaded to a document object cover.

evts.name: generate_document_from_template
evts.description: A new document is generated based on a selected document template in MS Office format.

evts.name: physical_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive period has expired.

A Workflow instance is associated with a Document for release, validity extension, override or reactivation.
